answers.core: It's basic functionality of nearly every game on the market. Just like ALT+F4 needs to kill applications unless there's a really good reason against or ALT+TAB should always switch applications unless there's a REALLY REALLY REALLY good reason against that.
answers.workaround: Of course, yes. But it will be used by every game unless the game is supposed to be a troll/subversive kind of game. The purpose of this is to provide usability/immersion to projects made by beginners. It is to help beginner game devs who are already overwhelmed by making a game and not have them think about window management.

title: By default, bind Alt + Enter to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode
